<a id="page-charts"></a>
# Charts, gauges and indicators

<a id="charts-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Showing numbers as pictures: progress bars and rings, activity spinners, badges, gauges, bar, line and series
charts, scatter plots and barcodes.

<a id="charts-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A goal's progress as a bar bound to a variable, and a week as a bar chart:

```json
{
  "schema": 4,
  "roots": ["stats"],
  "nodes": {
    "stats": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 300},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["goal", "bar", "week"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 300}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"crossAxisAlignment": "start", "spacing": 12}
    },
    "goal": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "${done} of 7 days", "style": {"fontSize": 15, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "bar": {
      "type": "progressBar",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 10},
      "props": {"max": 7, "color": "#FF16A34A", "backgroundColor": "#FFE5E7EB", "borderRadius": 5},
      "bind": {"props.value": "${done}"}
    },
    "week": {
      "type": "barChart",
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 342}, "height": 160},
      "props": {
        "values": [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0],
        "labels": ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"],
        "color": "#FF16A34A",
        "labelFontFamily": "Roboto"
      }
    }
  },
  "variables": {"stats": [{"name": "done", "type": "integer", "value": 4}]}
}
```

<a id="node-progressBar"></a>
### `progressBar`

Progress bar (bar or arc).

A progress bar filled to `value` of `max`: a bar (horizontal, or vertical filling upward) or an arc with ticks, bands and a needle.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exactFill` | bool | `false` |  | Bar: the fill is the exact fraction (false: whole percents, as a flex row of the two parts). |
| `clipFill` | bool | `false` |  | Bar: the fill is cut by the track's rounded shape (round only where the track is, square at its end) instead of rounded itself. |
| `value` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `max` | double | `100` |  |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FF000000"` |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#197F7F7F"` |  |  |
| `direction` | [Axis](values.md#enum-Axis) | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal`, `vertical` |  |
| `borderRadius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `0` |  |  |
| `animate` | bool | `false` |  | Animates changes of `value`. |
| `animationDuration` | int | `300` | ≥ 0 | Milliseconds. |
| `shape` | [ProgressBarShape](values.md#enum-ProgressBarShape) | `"bar"` | `bar`, `arc` |  |
| `arcStartAngle` | double | `150` |  |  |
| `arcSweepAngle` | double | `240` |  |  |
| `arcStrokeWidth` | double | `12` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `needleColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |

| `arcFit` | [ArcFit](values.md#enum-ArcFit) | `"arc"` | `arc`, `circle` |  |

<a id="node-circularProgressIndicator"></a>
### `circularProgressIndicator`

Flutter `CircularProgressIndicator`.

Flutter `CircularProgressIndicator`: a spinner, or a ring filled to `value`. `startAngle` and `sweepAngle` draw it as an arc (a dial).

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | double | unset |  | Filled fraction, 0–1; null spins (indeterminate). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `strokeWidth` | double | `4` | ≥ 0 |  |
| `strokeAlign` | double | `0` |  | -1 inside the bounds, 0 centered on them, 1 outside. |
| `strokeCap` | [StrokeCap](values.md#enum-StrokeCap) | unset | `butt`, `round`, `square` |  |
| `trackGap` | double | unset |  |  |
| `startAngle` | double | `-90` |  | Where the ring starts, in degrees clockwise from 3 o'clock. |
| `sweepAngle` | double | `360` |  | How much of the circle the ring spans, in degrees. |

<a id="node-plotChart"></a>
### `plotChart`

Plot chart (line/area over an x domain; with series, origin axes and a zero-anchored grid, a Cartesian graph).

A line/area chart of `points` spread evenly over an x domain, with an x value selected by tapping or dragging.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

### `barcode`

Barcode / QR code.

A barcode or QR code of `data`, filling the box.

- Children: none.
- Decoration: none: only blur effects in `decoration.effects` apply.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `symbology` | [BarcodeSymbology](values.md#enum-BarcodeSymbology) | `"qrCode"` | `qrCode`, `pdf417`, `code128`, `aztec`, `dataMatrix`, `ean13` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `"#FF000000"` |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  |  |
| `errorCorrection` | [BarcodeErrorCorrection](values.md#enum-BarcodeErrorCorrection) | `"medium"` | `low`, `medium`, `quartile`, `high` |  |
| `drawText` | bool | `true` |  | 1D codes: the text under the bars. |
| `overlap` | double | `0` | ≥ 0 | Pixels each dark bar and module reaches past its right and bottom edge, so neighbours overlap: no hairline seams where anti-aliased edges meet, and a small ink gain (as `canvas.drawRect` codes widen bars to hide seams). 0 draws the exact geometry. |

<a id="charts-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="charts-progress-from-state"></a>
### Progress from state

Bind the value (`"bind": {"props.value": "${done}"}`) with `max` the goal; `"animate": true` eases changes. A ring:
`progressBar` with `"shape": "arc"` (`arcSweepAngle` 360 for a full circle) or `circularProgressIndicator`.

<a id="charts-charts-from-data"></a>
### Charts from data

`barChart` and `lineChart` take plain lists (`values`, `labels`); bind them to computed variables
(`${= map(week, d => d.count)}`). `chart` draws series over data rows (`data`, `series`, `labelField`) as bars,
lines, areas, a timeline or a donut, with a selected index; `plotChart` plots x/y series with markers, ranges and
reference lines.

<a id="charts-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- Chart colours default to a dark theme's; set `color`, `gridColor` and the label colours on a light page.
- A `barChart`'s labels default to JetBrains Mono: set `labelFontFamily` to a font you have (`font_fallback`).
- A chart's size is its node's layout: give it a fixed height.
- `value` above `max` is clamped.
